scene: Day 240, the gas station forecourt from episode one under the ship's dark straight-edged slab, which fills the whole sky; no shadows anywhere. A crowd of stick-figure survivors stands back in a wide circle. In the middle, the Worker (plain mint-headed alien, dark suit, flat silver case open beside it) kneels on the pavement and sets down a glowing marker of THREE circles in a row, joined by two short lines. Reed (blue-gray scarf) and Mara (purple forearm band) stand right in front of it holding hands, staring down at the three circles. Behind them the Surveyor (blue shoulder stripe) waits by a small dark craft resting on the road; beside a lit pump stand the red fuel can and a faded milk carton. What makes it scary: for 240 days the circles came in pairs, and this one has three.

Day 234, seen from the gas station's canopy roof: Reed (blue-gray scarf) and Mara (purple forearm band) kneel at the edge of the roof looking out. Below them, the lit forecourt is full of tiny survivors in pairs wrapped in blankets. All around the station, the road, the bend and the field, hundreds of tall dark smooth units stand in a giant ring, joined circles glowing at every base. Low in the evening sky, a small dark shape with straight edges is growing. What makes it scary: they have watched rings like this lift people into the ship, and this time they are standing in the middle of one.
